title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

location.provenance: The People of the State of California do enact as follows:

reference.provenance: AB-2515 Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

status.provenance: An act to add Article 15 (commencing with Section 25258) to Chapter 6.5 of Division 20 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

date.provenance: [ Approved by Governor  September 30, 2024. Filed with Secretary of State September 30, 2024. ]

pfas_definition.provenance: “Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances” or “PFAS” means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: This bill would similarly prohibit any person from manufacturing, distributing, selling, or offering for sale in the state any menstrual products that contain regulated PFAS, as defined.

date.provenance: Existing law, beginning January 1, 2025, prohibits a person or entity from manufacturing, selling, delivering, holding, or offering for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as defined.
